description: This PHP source file defines the TaxRate controller class for the Opencart e-commerce platform's admin panel. The class manages CRUD operations for tax rates, including listing, creating, editing, and deleting tax rate entries, and handles related view rendering and data processing.

classes.name: TaxRate
classes.description: Controller class for managing tax rates in the admin panel of Opencart. Handles listing, creation, editing, and deletion of tax rate entries, along with generating context data for views and handling form submissions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main tax rate management page, setting up breadcrumbs, page titles, and loading the list of tax rates.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles Ajax request to retrieve and return the tax rate list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches paginated tax rate data, applies filters, and returns the rendered view for the tax rate list.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a tax rate, pre-filling data when editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submissions to create or update a tax rate entry; validates permissions and data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected tax rate entries after permission and dependency checks, returning success or error messages.
